verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no claims or documentation about how long it takes a founder to open and fully activate a Wise Business account — no onboarding timeline, sign-up flow speed, or verification turnaround is mentioned. The only tangential items describe account creation breadth (160+ countries) and API payment docs, not onboarding speed, and community evidence instead highlights account blocks/changes (wise-comm-6, wise-comm-3) rather than fast onboarding.
